class Flow {

  dynamic classify(dynamic n) {
    if (n < 0) return 'neg';
    else if (n == 0) return 'zero';
    else return 'pos';

  }

  void noop() {
  }

  void run(dynamic l, dynamic a) {
    for (var e in l) print('- ${e}');
    var i = 0;
    while( i < 3 ) i = i + 1;
    print('while: ${i}');
    if (a) print('x');
    else print('y');

    for (var e in l) {
      if (e > 2) print('gt2: ${e}');

    }
    if (a) {
        print('p1');
        print('q1');
    } else {
        print('p2');
        print('q2');
    }

    print(this.classify(-5));
    print(this.classify(0));
    print(this.classify(7));
    this.noop();
    print('done');
  }

}
